verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair capability to ask of a work-management and collaboration tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a whiteboard feature in Jira: its "boards" are task-tracking views, and the Figma, Confluence and Trello connections are integrations with other tools rather than a native whiteboard.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
